div.head: Cn 1018 14.1
div.ab: Sunnandæges freols healde man georne. swa þarto gebirige. 7 cipincga. 7 folcgemota. 7 huntaðfara. 7 worldlicra weorca. on ðam halgan dæge geswice man georne.
Sunnandæges freols healde man georne swa þarto gebirige, and cipincga, and folcgemota, and huntaðfara, and worldlicra weorca on ðam halgan dæge geswice man georne.
The festival of Sunday shall be zealously observed, in a proper manner, and trading and public meetings and hunting expeditions, and secular activities, shall be strictly avoided on the holy day.
And the Sunday holy day is to be diligently observed in the manner most appropriate for it, and markets, public meetings, hunts, and secular business are to be assiduously avoided on that holy day.
